name: [UPDATE 1 & +10🍀 ] Anime Card Realms
desc:
✨Anime Card Realms ✨

Step into the realms where cards hold the power of legends! Summon rare cards, forge powerful decks, and set off on an endless adventure across magical maps and the mysterious Infinite Castle. Face mighty bosses, climb on the leaderboards and test your luck with every roll!

How it Works
🎴 Summon Cards – Open packs with the Roll button and discover unique abilities, dazzling auras, and powerful combos.
⚔️ Form Your Party – Build strategies in your Deck and prepare for automated battles that play out with epic flair.
🌍 Explore Realms – Teleport into Story maps or climb the Infinite Castle for escalating challenges.
🍀 Power Up – Brew potions, craft gear, and unlock nodes to tilt fortune in your favor.
🐉 Defeat Bosses – Conquer npcs and bosses for exclusive rewards!

Available on PC and Mobile, with Console coming soon aswell!

Players who have premium get a +5 luck boost.

Group members get a +3 luck boost.

Use code: Release for some free rewards!
